$what: Every component under src/components that NOTHING in src/, apps/ or e2e/ imports, as of 2026-09-10. 21 of 192. On 2026-10-07 (M09-c115) 12 of them were deleted, with home/FeaturedProductsTabs and ui/label, which only they imported; 9 remain.
$why: A component with no importer is the most common defect shape in this project's history: a finished feature nobody wired up. Nothing counted them until this file existed. Demanding zero would have made the gate red on arrival, and the fix for a dead component is deletion, which is not a gate's call to force here -- three of these are re-export shims another path still uses, five are library surface, and two are cited by name in scripts/rtl-logical-scan.mjs and in other files' comments.
$rules: findUnimportedComponents in scripts/final-audit-lib.mjs. The gate: scripts/final-audit.mjs, tenth and eleventh rows.
$how_to_shrink_this: Wire it up or delete it, then strike the line. The gate FAILS on an entry that is now imported or gone, so this list cannot keep names of things already resolved. It is a ratchet: the 22nd dead component is refused.

src/components/home/Footer.tsx.detail: src/styles/tokens.css:193 still names it as the owner of --container-footer, which is why deleting it is a measured change and not a tidy-up.

src/components/product/WishlistButton.ts.detail: Its own header says SUPERSEDED BY components/wishlist/WishlistHeart.tsx on 2026-09-09, and it re-exports that component. Kept as a shim.

src/components/admin/CategoryTree.tsx.detail: Admin category tree with drag reorder. Three other files' comments cite it as the reference for buildTree and for the sort_order semantics, so the comments break with the file.

src/components/category/CategorySort.tsx.detail: Exports SORT_OPTIONS and a router-driven sort control. The category page ships its own sorting.

src/components/growth/NewsletterSignup.t.detail: Bound to the real subscribeToNewsletter server action. The action has no other caller either, so the newsletter has no entry point on the site.

src/components/legal/LegalDocumentView.t.detail: One renderer for every legal document, and the legal routes do not use it.

src/components/storefront/BlogPostHeader.detail: Emits the blog post JSON-LD as well as the header, so the structured data goes with it.

src/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx.detail: Also named in scripts/rtl-logical-scan.mjs's LTR island list, which is a second reference that breaks if the file goes.
